name: stage-exec
description: STAGE_EXEC answers ST_NOT_SUPPORTED when the director stages nothing; a director with a stager may answer ST_NOT_FOUND for a file it does not stage, else it answers the real path to start the image from (wire.md 3.4.14); the reply's path is not compared (it is wherever the director staged it). An unknown root is not asked.

steps.note: staging leaves the mounted file as it was
